sec: sec:A005: Prevent cross-customer data exposure / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:A005: Prevent cross-customer data exposure / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Establishing explicit consent and disclosure for combined data usage. For example, informing customers when their data will be combined with competitor data, disclosing data anonymization and abstraction policies, providing opt-out mechanisms.

sentences.text: Establishing explicit consent and disclosure for combined data usage.
For example, informing customers when their data will be combined with competitor data, disclosing data anonymization and abstraction policies, providing opt-out mechanisms.

blocks.id: blk:A005: Prevent cross-customer data exposure / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Implementing customer data isolation controls. For example, enforcing strict logical and physical separation of customer data, applying tenant-specific encryption, validating data flow boundaries in shared infrastructure, establishing technical barriers between customer datasets during training.
